correctness.rationale: Inspected complete eight-file Git tree, RESULT.md root-lifting proof, Python and C++ exact checkers. The eight monic mod-2 reductions partition into no-root, unique simple root, double-plus-simple, and triple-root types. Hensel simple lifts and factorization reduce mixed class to a uniformly selected quadratic square-root fiber; valuation cases construct Q_k. The triple-root class is partitioned by B,C divisibility: zero-root, two-root, or f(2Y)=8g(Y) with four lifted roots per g-root and 16 coefficient lifts, deriving 16P_{k-3}(z^4). Initial histograms, maximum comparison to square-root fiber and induction give the three-phase extremal counts; simple root parity in one mixed reduction is treated by translation. Independently exhaustively enumerated all cubics modulo 2,4,8,16 and compared histograms, recurrence and maxima. The finite enumeration corroborates but does not replace root-lift classification for all k.
